title: Southwest: Buy Rapid Rewards Points 50% Off
summary: 50% off purchased Rapid Rewards points — 1.5¢/pt (normally 3¢). Min 7,000, max 60,000 pts. Purchased points do NOT count toward A-List or Companion Pass. Only buy if you have a specific Southwest booking ready.
impactJustification: Valuable for Southwest loyalists with a specific redemption ready, but limited audience.

title: Hilton Amex Aspire: 175,000-Point Welcome Offer — Best Ever
summary: 175K Hilton points after $6,000 spend in 6 months (~$1,050 value). Card includes $550 AF, Diamond status, $400 resort credit, Priority Pass, free weekend night cert. Previous best was 150K — this is the highest offer ever seen on this card.
impactJustification: Affects a large subset — Hilton is one of the largest hotel programs with broad appeal.

title: Citi ThankYou → Virgin Atlantic Flying Club 30% Transfer Bonus
summary: 1,000 Citi TY points → 1,300 Virgin Atlantic miles. Eligible cards: Strata Elite, Strata Premier, Prestige. Virgin miles are particularly valuable for Delta One and ANA business class redemptions.
impactJustification: Citi is a major issuer; Virgin Atlantic is a high-value partner for premium cabin awards.

title: Citi ThankYou → Avianca LifeMiles 25% Transfer Bonus
summary: 1,000 Citi TY points → 1,250 LifeMiles. Eligible cards: Strata Elite, Strata Premier, Prestige, AT&T Access More. LifeMiles are strong for Star Alliance partner awards including Lufthansa, Turkish Airlines, and United business class.
impactJustification: Citi is a major issuer; LifeMiles enables premium Star Alliance redemptions not easily booked elsewhere.

title: Buy Air France-KLM Flying Blue Miles — Up to 80% Bonus
summary: Up to 80% bonus when purchasing Flying Blue miles directly through April 16. At ~1.5¢/mile with bonus applied, compelling for travelers with specific Flying Blue redemptions such as Promo Rewards or transatlantic premium cabin. Verify purchase price vs. redemption value before committing.
impactJustification: Flying Blue is a strong program but purchased miles audience is more niche.

title: Chase UR → Aeroplan 20% Transfer Bonus (30% for Cardholders)
summary: 1,000 Chase UR → 1,200 Aeroplan points. Aeroplan cardholders who transfer 50K+ get an additional 10% cardholder bonus for 30% total (capped at 25K bonus pts/year). Aeroplan is one of Chase's strongest partners — excellent for Star Alliance premium cabin awards including JAL, Lufthansa, and Air Canada.
impactJustification: Chase Ultimate Rewards affects the majority of points users; Aeroplan is a top-tier redemption partner.

title: Capital One → Japan Airlines Mileage Bank 30% Transfer Bonus
summary: Normal ratio 4:3 (750 JAL per 1,000 Cap1 miles). With 30% bonus the effective ratio becomes nearly 1:1. Eligible cards: Venture X, Venture, VentureOne, Spark Miles. JAL miles are excellent for ANA/JAL business class to Japan and Asia and oneworld premium cabin awards.
impactJustification: Capital One is a major issuer; JAL is a high-value oneworld partner with limited transfer bonus history.

title: Chase UR → IHG One Rewards 70% Transfer Bonus — Experts Advise Caution
summary: 1,000 Chase UR → 1,700 IHG points. IHG is widely considered Chase's least valuable transfer partner at ~0.5 cpp. Even at 1.7x, effective value is ~0.85 cpp versus ~1.7 cpp with other Chase partners. Expert consensus: do not transfer unless you have a specific IHG sweet-spot redemption already identified.
impactJustification: Chase affects majority of points users but this bonus is widely flagged as a poor-value trap.

title: American Airlines AAdvantage 'Ready, Set, Jet' — 500 Bonus Loyalty Points Per Flight
summary: 500 bonus Loyalty Points per qualifying American Airlines flight, up to 5,000 LP (10 flights), through April 30. No registration required. Strong incentive for members near AAdvantage status thresholds. LP count toward status qualification.
impactJustification: Meaningful for AAdvantage status chasers but limited to active American flyers.

title: Marriott Vacations: 25,000 Bonus Points on 4+ Night Hawaii/Florida Packages
summary: 25K bonus Bonvoy points on eligible Vacations by Marriott packages of 4+ nights at Hawaii or Florida properties. Travel window: April 1 – October 31, 2026. Book by April 30. High-value for members targeting Platinum status or building award night balances.
impactJustification: Niche — limited to travelers booking specific vacation packages in two markets.

title: Marriott Bonvoy Q1/Q2: 2,500 Bonus Points Per Stay + 1 Elite Night Per Brand
summary: Earn 2,500 bonus Bonvoy points per eligible paid stay plus 1 bonus elite night credit per Marriott brand stayed at, through May 10, 2026. No cap on qualifying stays. Award stays do not qualify. Registration required by April 26, 2026.
impactJustification: Marriott is one of the largest hotel programs; broad appeal for status chasers and frequent travelers.

title: Marriott Bonvoy Brilliant Amex: 200,000-Point Welcome Offer
summary: 200K Bonvoy points after $6,000 spend in 6 months (~$1,800 value at 0.9 cpp). Card includes $650 AF, $300 Marriott credit, Platinum Elite status, Priority Pass, and annual free night certificate up to 85K points. Strong for Marriott loyalists targeting top-tier redemptions.
impactJustification: Marriott is a major program; 200K is a historically strong welcome offer.

title: World of Hyatt Expanding to 5-Tier Award Chart — Effective May 2026
summary: Hyatt is replacing its 3-tier Off-Peak/Standard/Peak pricing with 5 tiers: Lowest/Low/Moderate/Upper/Top. Category 8 Top nights could reach 75,000 points per night — a 67% increase from the current 45,000 Peak rate. Limited properties move to Upper/Top in 2026 with broader adoption following. Fixed award chart pricing preserved. Book high-category properties now.
impactJustification: Affects majority of points users — Hyatt is the top hotel program for award value; 67% increase at top properties is significant.

title: World of Hyatt 2026 Annual Category Review — 7 Properties Reclassified
summary: Effective April 2026: Moving up 2 categories: Grand Hyatt Grand Cayman Resort & Spa. Moving up 1 category: Andaz Pattaya Jomtien Beach, Hyatt Centric Malta, Hyatt Regency Kotor Bay Resort, Hyatt Place San Antonio-NW/Medical Center, Grand Hyatt Incheon. Moving down 1 category: The Barnett, JdV by Hyatt (potential new sweet spot).
impactJustification: Meaningful for travelers targeting these specific properties but limited in overall breadth.

title: Major United MileagePlus Earning & Award Changes Now Live
summary: Effective April 2, 2026: Cardholders earn 9–20% more miles on United flights; non-cardholders earn 18–40% fewer. Basic Economy flyers without status or a co-brand card now earn 0 miles. Cardholders receive 10%+ off United award prices; Premier cardholders get 15%+. Children can link accounts to earn at parent cardholder rates.
impactJustification: United MileagePlus is one of the largest programs; these changes affect all United flyers.

title: Delta SkyMiles × Hawaiian Airlines Partnership Officially Over
summary: The Delta/Hawaiian Airlines partnership ended June 30, 2025. The final travel deadline for existing Hawaiian award tickets was April 1, 2026. Members seeking Hawaii travel must now use Delta-operated flights or pivot to Alaska/Atmos, United MileagePlus partner awards, or Aeroplan for Air Canada Hawaii routes.
impactJustification: Closes a popular Hawaii redemption corridor but primary deadline has now passed.

title: Alaska/Atmos Rewards Stealth Award Chart Update — New Distance Band Added
summary: Following the Mileage Plan → Atmos Rewards rebrand and Hawaiian Airlines merger, Alaska quietly added a new pricing band for 3,501+ mile itineraries — a stealth devaluation for some long-haul routes. A partner award pricing glitch on Finnair and Iberia connections was spotted and fixed. Sweet spots remain for intra-Alaska/Hawaii travel. Community is closely monitoring Atmos for further post-merger changes. Do not transfer into Atmos without checking current pricing first.
impactJustification: Alaska/Atmos is a niche but beloved program for creative oneworld redemptions.
